title: adoption: the method in any repository
intent: The method was measured on three foreign projects and worked on them only by hand: the first claims were written by a person, the page for an agent was copied by a person, and a greenfield project could not make its first claim at all. The plan said six steps and none of them was adoption, so the adoption was done here: a wave can be made, a promise may precede its subject, the page is generated and installed, a project with code has a first step, the stand travels, the binary names itself, and the machine surface gives the next step.
objection: Adoption is friction: every new verb is a place where the method can get in the way of an agent, and the method's own rule is that friction belongs only where the agent errs. Seven new verbs and a law are a lot of surface for a method whose measured value is knowledge, not caught defects.
refuted_by: The map and the queue of an adopting project: if the verbs lead an agent to a wrong step, the map will show it. And the counter is measured: the agent arm of 2026-11-07 is repeated with this build - if the protocol arm still catches no defect that the bare arm misses, the added surface buys nothing and the objection stands.
